theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (s : ℝ) (ψ l : ℝ → ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → 0 < s → s ≤ 1 / 4 → ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → ContDiff ℝ 1 l → tsupport ψ ⊆ Ioo (-s) s → tsupport l ⊆ Ioo (1 - s) (1 + s) → ∃ g : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ (∀ x v : Euclid P, inner ℝ x v = 0 → (0 < inner ℝ x a → |‖x‖ - 1| < s → |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s → ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s / 2 * ‖x‖ ∨ 2 * s * ‖x‖ < ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖) → x ∈ {y : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ y a ∧ |‖y‖ - 1| < s ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a)| < s ∧ ‖y - Q.starProjection y‖ < s * ‖y‖} → fderiv ℝ g x v = deriv ψ (Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)) * l ‖x‖ * (inner ℝ (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a) v / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2)) ∧ (∀ x v : Euclid P, inner ℝ x v = 0 → (0 < inner ℝ x a → |‖x‖ - 1| < s → |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s → ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s / 2 * ‖x‖ ∨ 2 * s * ‖x‖ < ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖) → x ∉ {y : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ y a ∧ |‖y‖ - 1| < s ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a)| < s ∧ ‖y - Q.starProjection y‖ < s * ‖y‖} → fderiv ℝ g x v = 0)
